title: Hexhibit Exhibition
description: One Hexhibit lesson: a title, seven required messages, and 3 to 6 artworks that each own exactly one puzzle. The door code is generated by the game each time the player steps inside; exhibitions do not contain it. The runtime validator in assets/js/content.js enforces these rules; this schema documents them for authors and editors. The ?exhibition=<relative path> URL parameter loads an exhibition from a same-site relative path. It is a testing aid and is not a share link.

messages.description: Exhibition-specific dialog copy. All seven keys are required strings.

doorUnlocked.description: Prompt shown when the door is activated after escaping.

doorNudge.description: Shown when a wrong door code is submitted.

digitsFound.description: Progress text. May contain the placeholders {found} and {total}.

ui.description: Optional interface strings. Every key is an optional string. Missing keys fall back to the Default Exhibition at runtime.

escapeCta.description: Label of the Daylight Gallery button that starts the escape room.

afterHoursHint.description: Hint shown when After-Hours starts. Should cover both pointer and keyboard use.

solvedMarker.description: Text marker shown on a solved painting.

viewedMarker.description: Text marker shown on a gallery frame the player has inspected.

lockedLabel.description: Door state label while the door is locked.

unlockedLabel.description: Door state label once the door is unlocked.

galleryProgress.description: Gallery progress text. May contain the placeholders {viewed} and {total}.

modeAnnouncement.description: Screen reader announcement made when After-Hours begins.

sessionResumed.description: Screen reader announcement made when a saved escape room session is restored.

artworks.description: 3 to 6 artworks. Corridor length, code length and counters follow from the count. Ids must be unique (enforced at runtime).

artwork.description: One framed painting with plaque details, a lesson and one puzzle. Unknown optional fields are allowed. Images are generated gradients from colors; no image data is embedded.

id.description: Unique artwork id. Also used as the puzzle id.

year.description: A string so values such as "c. 1884" work.

colors.description: Two 6-digit CSS hex colors for the generated gradient image.

image.description: Optional day image. A relative path under assets/images/art/ ending in .jpg, .jpeg, .png or .webp. No scheme, leading slash, backslash, ".." segment, query or fragment. When absent or failing to load, the gradient from colors is shown. Requires credit.

hauntedImage.description: Optional haunted night variant. Same path rule as image. Requires image to also be set.

alt.description: Optional accessible description of the image. Defaults to the title.

credit.description: Credit line for the image. Required whenever image is set.

puzzle.description: A puzzle with common fields plus fields specific to its type. Unknown optional fields are allowed.

type.description: Puzzle type registered in assets/js/puzzles/index.js. This spec ships "riddle" and "choice".

nudge.description: Short helpful message after a wrong answer.

explanation.description: One line on why the correct answer works.

digit.description: Deprecated and ignored. The door code is generated per game, so any value here is accepted and has no effect.

answers.description: Accepted answers. Compared after trim, whitespace collapse and lower-casing. Each must be non-empty after normalizing.

options.description: Selectable options, shown in the order given.

correctIndex.description: Zero-based index into options. Must be less than options.length (enforced at runtime).
